map.武术/套路比赛演练：不同拳种规定完成时间（长拳70-90s、南拳65-85s、太: Martial arts and forms competition practice: each style sets its completion time (long boxing 70-90 s, southern boxing 65-85 s, tai chi 300-420 s, tai chi sword 180-240 s, broadsword / spear / straight sword / staff 70-90 s); the watch stops as soon as the weapon routine ends, and the tool compares the time with the standard and estimates deductions.

map.裁判/教练复核：现场输入实测耗时与该项目标准，立即得偏差与是否在允许范围，支持赛: Referee and coach review: enter the measured time and the standard for the event on site to get the deviation and whether it is within the allowed range immediately, supporting rhythm calibration before a competition.
map.算例：长拳标准比对: Worked example: comparison against the long boxing standard
map.长拳标准时长范围 70-90s，标准取值=(70+90)/2=80s，容差2s。:
The standard duration range for long boxing is 70-90 s, the standard value = (70 + 90)/2 = 80 s and the tolerance is 2 s.
Measured 85 s: deviation = 85 − 80 = +5 s, and since 70 ≤ 85 ≤ 90 it is within the allowed range → status good, and as neither the upper nor the lower limit is exceeded the estimated deduction = 0.
Measured 95 s: deviation = +15 s, and since 95 > 90 it exceeds the upper limit → status slow, deduction = (95 − 90) × 0.5 = 2.5 points (0.5 points per second over).
Note: tai chi styles are not subject to the lower-limit deduction (being slow at the lower bound is not penalized), while other styles are penalized by the same rule when below the lower limit.
map.标准时长是怎么定的？: How is the standard duration set?
map.各拳种竞赛规则规定演练时间区间（如长拳 70-90s、太极拳 300-420s）: The competition rules of each style set the practice time range (for example long boxing 70-90 s, tai chi 300-420 s) and the standard value is the midpoint of that range; a deviation within the tolerance is rated excellent, within the range good, and outside the range an estimated 0.5 points are deducted per second over.
map.为什么太极拳不扣下限？: Why is tai chi not penalized at the lower bound?
map.太极拳讲究缓慢匀称，规则对「过快」通常不做下限扣分（下限偏快反而影响韵味），只对: Tai chi emphasizes slow, even movement, and the rules usually do not deduct for being too fast at the lower bound (being too fast spoils the flavour), only for exceeding the time limit; other, faster styles are constrained by both the lower and upper bounds.
map.必须用页面计时器吗？: Must I use the on-page timer?
map.不必。可用「▶ 开始 / ⏹ 停止」计时，也可直接在「完成耗时（秒）」框手动录入: No. You can use Start / Stop to time the run, or enter a known result directly into the completion time (seconds) box (for example an old coaching record or a reading from another device); whichever valid time you have is used for the comparison. If no valid time is entered, the speed ratio and the deduction are not shown, avoiding meaningless ratios.
map.实测耗时取手动输入值，无输入时取计时值；偏差 = 实测 − 标准时长；速度比率: Measured time comes from the manual input, or from the timer when empty; deviation = measured − standard duration; speed ratio = standard duration ÷ measured × 100%; penalty = seconds beyond the lower bound (taiji routines are exempt) or above the upper bound × 0.5 points/s; Rating: |deviation| ≤ tolerance → excellent, within [lower, upper] → good, below the lower bound → too fast, otherwise too slow; timer display = ⌊seconds/60⌋ minutes + remaining seconds + tenths of a second
map.标准时长和容差怎么校验？: How are standard time and tolerance validated?
map.标准时长必须大于 0 秒；容差可为 0（表示只接受完全一致），超过 30 秒则报: Standard time must be greater than 0 s; tolerance may be 0 (exact match only) and must not exceed 30 s. An empty completion time shows an input prompt only; 0 or negative values raise an error and clear old conclusions.
map.太极拳讲究缓慢匀称，规则对「过快」通常不做下限扣分，只对超时扣分；其余快节奏拳种: Tai chi values slow, even movement, so its rules usually do not deduct for going too fast, only for exceeding the upper limit; other fast routines are bounded at both ends.
map.清空完成耗时会沿用上次计时吗？: Does clearing the time reuse the last timer result?
map.不会。清空或输入无效时只显示录入提示并清除旧结论；如需使用计时结果，请点「📋 使: No. Clearing or entering an invalid value shows an input prompt and clears old results; to use the timer result, click “📋 Use timer result” explicitly.
